html:
At Run Time is a fast-paced parkour game where you take on the role of a Runner who has stolen a powerful generator from a gold refinery. The stolen power source continuously builds up energy and is destined to explode, turning every run into a deadly race against time.

Rotating blades, crushing hammers, fire-spewing pipes, and the ever-present threat of detonation stand between you and freedom. Power up traps throughout each level to gain precious extra seconds. Choose carefully, however, every advantage comes with deadly consequences.

Designed for experienced players and speedrunning enthusiasts, At Run Time features a fluid movement system that is easy to learn but challenging to master. Compete against players worldwide through online leaderboards that rank each level based on completion time.

MASTER ADVANCED PARKOUR

Combine advanced movement techniques such as wall jumps, slides, and vaults to overcome a brutal environment filled with obstacles.

SURVIVE DEADLY MECHANICAL TRAPS

Dodge rotating blades, crushing hammers, and countless lethal hazards hidden throughout the refinery.

MANAGE THE TIMER

Time is always running out. Activate traps to earn precious extra seconds but beware of  the dangerous effects they unleash.

EXPERIENCE SEAMLESS PROGRESSION

Race through each level without interruption thanks to a completely loading-screen-free experience.

BUILT FOR SPEEDRUNNING

Optimize your routes, master every movement, and discover risky shortcuts to achieve record-breaking times.

PURE MOVEMENT-DRIVEN GAMEPLAY

No combat. No weapons. Survival depends entirely on your precision, reflexes, and mastery of movement.
